_about: End-to-end tailoring cases: each builds a real user, resume and job in the local test database, then runs planner -> diagnosis -> editor (question and/or edit) -> the server's validation with the real model. `expect` is the acceptable final outcome: keep (no question, no edit), rewrite (an edit, no question), ask (exactly one question, then an edit once `answer` is given), confirm (the server's establish-use question). `answers` are from an EARLIER run; `answer` answers this run's question. `expect_diagnosis` is the acceptable diagnosis decision, null meaning the bullet never reaches diagnosis (settled or confirmed first); it is checked separately, so an editor that happens to keep cannot hide a diagnosis that wanted needless work.
